NetDiscovery.cpp contains experimental ND_ACK/ANNOUNCE handlers and an infinite one-second-delay loop with last-octet identity; the header declarations/configuration are commented out. These are not a reusable NetBIOS or LLDP implementation. Retain the useful LAN discovery intent using actual product identity and bounded per-interface services, not a claimed byte-for-byte port.

New S3 NBNS adapts the installed Arduino3.3.12/ESP8266 first-level name encoding plus RFC1002 bounded NB/NBSTAT messages into loop-owned nonblocking exact-netif UDP137 listeners; no task-owned AsyncUDP buffer, silent hostname truncation, SMB advertisement or wrong-subnet reply. LLDP is a separate pinned-IDF native Ethernet link diagnostic, not donor ND protocol parity.
